title: Parity-disjoint variable namespaces for arbitrary CNF components
claim: For every pair of CNFs f and g, renaming every variable in f by leftVar n = 2*n and every variable in g by rightVar n = 2*n+1 produces disjoint variable sets, under the exact enrolled list-based CNF definitions. The proof extracts a preimage from each renamed variable occurrence and derives a contradiction between its even and odd representations.
novelty: A newly written 516-byte Lean proof expression integrating an elementary, established parity fact with this repository's exact CNF definitions. This is formalization and integration, not new mathematical discovery or a first-formalization claim. It proves disjointness only; earlier credited renaming and satisfiability-preservation results are not claimed again. This is a disclosed project-agent pilot submission, not independent outside research.
